message: ChartMogul is a subscription analytics platform that connects to a company's billing systems and builds a subscription revenue model from that data to report MRR, ARR, churn, retention and expansion. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: One email introduces ChartMogul as a subscription analytics platform for recurring-revenue reporting and gives one next step: start the 14-day free Pro trial and connect Stripe, Paddle, or another billing system, after which ChartMogul builds the subscription model automatically so MRR and related recurring-revenue metrics come from one model instead of hand-joined exports. A customer testimonial (OneVision) is used as proof that normalizing billing data in ChartMogul produced defensible, dollar-level revenue clarity. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
